title: God of War
summary: White specks on characters in dim light: an EQUAL depth test after a prepass, which the translated shaders do not match bit for bit. Recommended instead of the fix: DXMT with DXMT_CONFIG="d3d11.defuseFma=True" in the game's launch options removes them with nothing installed (2026-10-26); the fix draws nearby grass and branches as solid shapes in some scenes.

credits.name: The author of "God Of War 2018 White Dot Fix (through Crossover)" on r/macgaming
credits.note: Found the depth test behind the white specks.

excerpts.note: Every depth state that tests EQUAL is created with the replacement test read from gow-depth-fix.ini, which removes the white specks.
